subject: Television & Streaming
title: Planet Earth and Environmental Awareness
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Planet Earth and Environmental Awareness.

hook.text: David Attenborough's Planet Earth showed the natural world in breathtaking detail. It also showed a planet in crisis.

buildup.text: The series used cutting-edge cameras to film animals and landscapes never seen before.

discovery.text: Blue Planet II's footage of plastic pollution in oceans sparked a global anti-plastic movement.

twist.text: The UK government cited Blue Planet II when introducing its plastic ban.

climax.text: Planet Earth and Environmental Awareness matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: A nature documentary did more for the planet than most policy papers.

quiz.question: What policy impact did Blue Planet II have in the UK?
options: The government cited it when introducing a plastic ban
